description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for the media_library module, including theme hooks, preprocess functions for media library elements, media entities, and views.

classes.name: MediaLibraryThemeHooks
classes.description: Class implementing hook functions for media_library theme and preprocessing in Drupal.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Defines theme hooks for media library templates.

methods.name: preprocessMediaLibraryWrapper
methods.description: Prepares variables for media library modal dialog template.

methods.name: preprocessMediaLibraryItem
methods.description: Prepares variables for a selected media item template.

methods.name: preprocessMedia
methods.description: Preprocesses media entities for media library view mode, adding cache contexts and URL.

methods.name: preprocessViewsViewFields
methods.description: Adds CSS classes to media rendered entity fields for JavaScript targeting.

methods.name: preprocessViewsViewMediaLibrary
methods.description: Adds data-view-display-id attribute to the media library view.
